details: The Clarity Act, a long-awaited crypto market structure bill, is expected to advance in May following a compromise among lawmakers. This legislative progress is viewed as a major catalyst that could unlock billions in sidelined institutional capital, potentially pushing Bitcoin towards $90,000 and even $100,000 by mid-2026. Bitcoin has recently demonstrated resilience, holding above the $75,000 mark.
title: White House Crypto Bill Advances, Bitcoin Targets $90K

details: Jerome Powell's anticipated departure as Federal Reserve Chair and Kevin Warsh's potential nomination in May 2026 are introducing significant uncertainty into monetary policy. This leadership transition has historically been linked to volatility in Bitcoin prices. Warsh's hawkish stance and the Federal Reserve's recent decision to maintain interest rates have already contributed to a Bitcoin selloff below $75,000, casting skepticism on immediate higher price targets.
title: Fed Leadership Change Creates Bitcoin Uncertainty, Selloff Risk

details: Bitcoin is currently consolidating around $78,281, trading sideways despite reaching record highs in traditional tech stocks. While there was a modest reversal in spot Bitcoin ETF activity, seeing approximately $4.5 million in net inflows after several days of losses, the digital currency still faces resistance near the $80,000 threshold. The broader crypto market is showing a bullish tilt with many altcoins rising, and the Fear & Greed Index has moved from "Fear" to "Neutral," signaling recovering sentiment among investors.
title: Bitcoin Consolidates Amid Mixed ETF Flows, Altcoin Sentiment Recovers

details: XRP spot Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) have concluded their longest inflow streak of 2026, which ran for 20 trading days from April 10 to April 29. The streak ended on April 30 with a $5.83 million outflow, leading to XRP's price slipping below the $1.40 support level. Despite steady ETF demand previously helping to hold the price, it was insufficient to break the $1.45 resistance.
title: XRP ETFs End Inflow Streak, Price Dips Below $1.40
